title: What are you fighting for?
html:
In fairytales it is always clear who the hero or heroine is fighting against and what they are fighting for. In some stories they might be tested before being given great powers and having to fight an evil wizard attempting to take over the world, or a powerful dragon intent on keeping a beautiful princess.

The end for them is always clear too: They must fight because they believe there is something bigger at stake, their world or their way of life, and the testing and fighting is a means to an end.

The evil prince or dastardly wizard is only there for the fight. There is nothing beyond it. They are thinking only of destroying the hero and nothing beyond that.

What are you fighting for? What is the fairytale ending that fuels you to fight the good fight?

This week I recommend putting together a powerpoint, or visual presentation, of the fairytale ending you would like and putting it in a folder on your desktop where you can easily view it whenever you like.

Keeping what you are fighting for at the forefront of your thoughts will ensure you get your fairytale ending.

Have a terrific week and keep fighting.
